company.shortDescription: Zulily is an online retailer that offers consumers with daily product deals.
company.description:
zulily is retailer focused on delivering customers special finds every day—all at incredible prices. zulily features an always-fresh curated collection of products for the whole family, including clothing, home decor, toys, gifts and more. zulily was launched in 2010 by Darrell Cavens and Mark Vadon and today, millions of people discover something new on zulily every day.

zulily is headquartered in Seattle with offices in Nevada and Ohio. zulily’s shares are traded on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol ZU.

aiResearchSummary.text: Zulily is researching methods to enhance search results for newly added items in their database. This involves using machine learning to map historical items to new entries, improving dynamic information retrieval in a cold start setting. This approach aims to optimize the user experience by providing more relevant search results, aligning with Zulily's focus on offering daily product deals.
